profile.name: BANGKOK DUSIT MEDICAL SERVICES PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED
profile.businessType: The Company operates in the large private hospital business with networks in Thailand and Cambodia.  The Company operates under 6 hospital groups, namely, Bangkok Hospital Group, Samitivej Hospital Group, BNH Hospital, Phyathai Hospital Group, Paolo Hospital Group and Royal Hospital Group.  In addition, the Company?s network also covers businesses that support medical care such as medical laboratories, medicine production and saline production.
profile.address: 2 SOI SOONVIJAI 7, NEW PETCHABURI ROAD, BANGKAPI, HUAY KWANG Bangkok 10310
profile.dividendPolicy: The company's policy is to pay dividends at no less than 50% of the net profit of the consolidated financial statements, depending on business expansion and capital requirements of the Company in each year, as approved by the shareholders, except for interim dividends which may be approved by the Board of Directors if the Board deems that the Company has had good operating results and sufficient liquidity.
